title: Enhance Add Account Dialog with Live Search, Custom Prop Firm Addition, and Fix Submission Error

requirements.text: Implement live search functionality in AddAccountDialog prop firm dropdown that filters the 55+ prop firms as the user types, supporting case-insensitive partial name matching throughout the firm name

quotes: search box filter prop firms as you type, or do you want a full autocomplete dropdown And should the search be case-insensitive and match partial names

acceptanceCriteria: Search input field appears above or within the prop firm dropdown
Typing in search box immediately filters displayed prop firms
Search matches partial strings anywhere in firm name (case-insensitive)
Empty search shows all 55+ firms from PROP_FIRMS constant
Clear search functionality resets filter to show all firms

requirements.text: Add 'Add your Prop firm' option in AddAccountDialog that allows users to manually enter a custom prop firm name when their firm is not listed in the dropdown

quotes: if Porpfirm not listed user shd have option to add Propfirm manually - Add your Prop firm

acceptanceCriteria: 'Add your Prop firm' option is visible in the dropdown or as a separate action button
Clicking the option opens an input field or inline form to enter custom firm name
User can type any custom prop firm name without validation constraints
Custom firm name is immediately available for selection in current session

requirements.text: Store custom prop firms entered by users in the backend user profile and cache them in frontend localStorage for faster access across sessions and devices

quotes: should it be saved to their profile so they can reuse it for future accounts
also cached locally in the frontend for faster access

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor method in main.mo saves custom prop firm names to user profile in stable storage
Custom firms are associated with the authenticated user's principal
Frontend stores custom firms in localStorage after successful backend save
On component mount, AddAccountDialog loads custom firms from localStorage and merges with PROP_FIRMS constant
Custom firms persist across browser sessions and device logins
Duplicate custom firm names are prevented

requirements.text: Fix the dropdown scrolling issue in AddAccountDialog where the prop firm dropdown opens but does not scroll properly through the list of firms
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown properly displays vertical scrollbar when firm list exceeds visible height
Mouse scroll and keyboard arrow keys navigate through full list of firms
Dropdown height is constrained to reasonable maximum (e.g., 300-400px)
Selected firm remains visible when dropdown closes
Dropdown z-index ensures it appears above other form elements

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the account submission error in AddAccountDialog that shows 'failed to add account' message when users attempt to submit the form with valid data

quotes: failed to add account while adding account
it show an error message when you try to submit

acceptanceCriteria: Investigate backend actor method for adding accounts (addAccount or similar) in main.mo
Verify account data structure matches frontend submission format
Check for authentication/authorization issues preventing account creation
Ensure proper error handling and meaningful error messages
Fix any data type mismatches between frontend and backend
Successfully added accounts appear immediately in Accounts.tsx dashboard
Success toast displays 'Account added successfully' on successful submission
Form clears and dialog closes after successful account addition

requirements.text: Update the prop firm dropdown in AddAccountDialog to display both the default 55+ firms from PROP_FIRMS constant and user's custom-added firms in a merged, sorted list
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown shows all firms from PROP_FIRMS constant plus user's custom firms
Combined list is alphabetically sorted
Custom firms are visually distinguishable (optional badge or icon)
Search functionality works across both default and custom firms
Dropdown performance remains smooth with combined list

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or useActor.ts
Do not add validation constraints for custom prop firm names
Preserve existing dark navy background with teal/green accent color scheme
Keep all existing prop firms in PROP_FIRMS constant unchanged
nonGoals: Admin interface for managing custom prop firms
Sharing custom prop firms between users
Prop firm logo uploads or visual branding
Auto-complete suggestions from external prop firm databases
Validation of prop firm legitimacy or compliance
